historical_model_provenance.scope: released cached judgments and answers; no current Qwen inference

reader_initialization.scope: Python dependency imports before primitive replay; no model weights loaded

primary_contrasts.acceptance: all three lower bounds >0; no typed-loss increase versus raw or scalar
primary_contrasts.missing: retain every slot with missing reason and worst-case bounds
primary_contrasts.null_stop: no further tuning on exposed test questions without new evidence or a different registered causal mechanism

typed_decision.exploratory_gate: lower95 > 0 and decision loss does not increase

primary_contrasts.unit: 100 whole test questions averaged over three siblings and five seeds
